scope: Targeted source follow-up after owner confirmation of Settings EMUI 10.0.0 / 10.0.0.562(C431E15R2P7). Six exact-model/build and official-rollback search queries; not an exhaustive proof of impossibility.

sources.observation: Generic EMUI-10-to-9 instructions use HiSuite's switch-to-another-version control and require HiSuite 9.1.0.303_OVE or newer. They do not identify .562/C431 eligibility or supply a method when this option is absent.
sources.limit: Not a verified exact-device rollback chain; the guide does not justify forcing packages or assuming an older client will expose a usable offer.

sources.observation: Vendor still explicitly requires Android 9 for the documented persistent bootloader unlock and hardware or software testpoint entry. Android 10 does not meet that documented prerequisite.

sources.kind: Firsthand owner failure claim with unverified replies
sources.access: Page text retrieved successfully; visible replies dated February/March 2024
sources.observation: P30 Lite owner explicitly reports starting at 10.0.0.562 and failures when attempting Android 9 and an earlier Android-10 build through HiSuite-Proxy. Replies suggest package/client changes; the visible owner reply does not establish success.
sources.limit: This is a reported failure, not proof of a hardware rollback barrier or a working recipe. No package-substitution, low-level-format or software instructions from replies were executed. Personal handles, screenshots and unrelated forum content are omitted.

sources.observation: Vendor advertises software-testpoint access up to Android 10 / EMUI 10, explicitly not guaranteed and sometimes requiring Android 9 first. This describes entry to service mode, not persistent bootloader unlock. No phone operation attempted.

The broad Android-10-without-downgrade wording appears in the June 2020 entry for identity-repair services and a CPU list without Kirin 710. A later entry adds Kirin 710 service features. Neither overrides the dedicated bootloader-unlock guide requiring Android 9 or demonstrates a persistent .562 unlock.

result: No verified end-to-end .562/C431 software-only persistent unlock or accepted Android-9 chain established by this follow-up. No vendor contacted, purchase made, tool run or phone operation performed by the research environment.
